verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers cron-based scheduled jobs through its CLI, a gated advanced feature. It also offers structured extraction (extract_rules, ai_query) and an Amazon pricing API, so a data engineer could poll target pages and pull out price or listing fields on a schedule. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in change detection or notification; diffing and alerting would have to be built by the user. Missing for 10: native change detection/diffing between runs, push notifications or webhooks on change, documentation of a monitoring workflow, independent corroboration.
